INSERT INTO pre_send_for_lm(recipient,recipient_email,cc,cc_email) SELECT lower(uar.line_manager) as recipient, lower(lm.email) as recipient_email, string_agg(distinct lower(uar.it_code_of_user), ',') as cc, string_agg(distinct u.email, ',') as cc_email FROM user_access_review uar LEFT JOIN ad_tb_upp_nature_2 lm on uar.line_manager = lm.user_name LEFT JOIN ad_tb_upp_nature_2 u on uar.it_code_of_user = u.user_name
lm.band_flag = '0' AND uar.line_manager_review_status='1' AND uar.delete_flag = '0' AND u.email != '' AND u.email is not null
GROUP BY lower(uar.line_manager),lower(lm.email)

INSERT INTO pre_send_for_lm (recipient,recipient_email,cc,cc_email,data_source) SELECT d.delegatee, u.email, pre.cc, pre.cc_email, d.delegator FROM pre_send_for_lm pre JOIN delegation d ON pre.recipient = d.delegator AND d.delegation_scope = 'Line_Manager' AND d.delegation_start_date <= current_date AND d.delegation_end_date >= current_date LEFT JOIN ad_tb_upp_nature_2 u ON d.delegatee = u.user_name WHERE u.band_flag='0';
mapper.select: SELECT pre.id, pre.recipient AS to, pre.recipient_email AS toEmail, pre.cc AS cc, pre.cc_email AS ccEmail FROM pre_send_for_lm pre
SELECT pre.id, pre.recipient AS to, pre.recipient_email AS toEmail FROM pre_send_for_user_will_remove pre
mapper.update:
WITH bpo_info AS ( SELECT bpo_arr[ord] AS bpo, NULLIF(bpo_email_arr[ord], '') AS bpo_email FROM user_access_review uar, LATERAL (SELECT string_to_array(lower(uar.bpo), ';') AS bpo_arr, string_to_array(lower(uar.bpo_email), ';') AS bpo_email_arr ) parsed, LATERAL generate_series( 1, GREATEST( array_length(parsed.bpo_arr, 1), array_length(parsed.bpo_email_arr, 1) ) ) AS t(ord) WHERE uar.bpo_review_status = '1' AND uar.delete_flag = '0' AND parsed.bpo_arr[ord] IS NOT NULL
) INSERT INTO pre_send_for_bpo (recipient, recipient_email) SELECT b.bpo, COALESCE(MAX(b.bpo_email), p.email) AS email FROM bpo_info b LEFT JOIN ad_tb_upp_nature_2 p ON p.user_name = b.bpo GROUP BY b.bpo, p.email;

INSERT INTO pre_send_for_bpo (recipient, recipient_email, data_source) SELECT DISTINCT d.delegatee, u.email, d.delegator FROM pre_send_for_bpo pre JOIN delegation d ON pre.recipient = d.delegator AND d.delegation_scope = 'BPO' AND d.delegation_start_date <= current_date AND d.delegation_end_date >= current_date LEFT JOIN ad_tb_upp_nature_2 u ON d.delegatee = u.user_name WHERE u.band_flag='0' ON CONFLICT (recipient) DO NOTHING;
mapper.select: SELECT id, recipient AS to, recipient_email AS toEmail FROM pre_send_for_bpo
mapper.update: INSERT INTO pre_send_for_reminder_user(recipient, recipient_email) select distinct lower(atun.user_name),lower(atun.email) from user_access_review uar left join ad_tb_upp_nature_2 atun on lower(uar.it_code_of_user) = lower(atun.user_name) where (line_manager_review_status = '1' or bpo_review_status = '1' ) and atun.band_flag = '0' and uar.line_manager not in( select user_name from ad_tb_upp_nature_2 where band_flag = '1' ) and atun.email is not null and atun.email != '' and uar.delete_flag = '0'
mapper.select: SELECT id, recipient AS to, recipient_email AS toEmail FROM pre_send_for_reminder_user
